verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Chargebee generates invoices: quotes can be converted to regular invoices, VAT can be added to the invoice amount, and exports can produce zip/pdf output. Nothing addresses the specific elements of the story. missing for 10: credit note generation, receipts, sequential/compliant numbering, custom fields on invoices, memos/notes, automatic delivery of invoices to customers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
